summary: Tompkins Financial Corp filed an 8-K (Items 2.02, 8.01, 9.01) reporting its first-quarter 2026 earnings—diluted EPS of $1.82 ($26.1M net income, up 32.5% YoY but down 72.9% QoQ)—and a Board-declared quarterly dividend of $0.67/share payable May 15, 2026 to holders of record May 8, 2026. There is no transaction, no change of control, no board recommendation/advisor, and no special-situation structure. The filing is purely a routine earnings and dividend announcement. What to watch: no risk-arb angle exists; this is an ordinary operating update.
